completeness.description: A deliberately small sample drawn from the 2022 NCES CCD and IPEDS directory files. Every record is empirical and row-locatable, but the set is NOT the national universe of U.S. schools, districts or postsecondary institutions. Absence of an institution from this corpus establishes nothing about whether it exists.
completeness.selectionBasis: Hand-selected rows covering the jurisdictions exercised by existing regression fixtures, plus a spread of institution kinds and levels.
